title: Octal or Hexadecimal to Decimal

content.problemStatement: Write a program to accept a number as input (Octal or Hexadecimal) from the user and print it decimal equivalent.
constraints: Valid octal or hex representation up to 32-bit int

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input '0144' produces expected output '' following problem rules.
Input '0x64' produces expected output '' following problem rules.

solution.approach: Parse an octal (leading 0) or hexadecimal (leading 0x) string and print its decimal value.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Use auto-detect radix parsing (such as %i in C scanf, or base-16/base-8 checking in Python/JS).

hints: Numbers starting with '0x' or '0X' are hexadecimal.
Numbers starting with '0' followed by digits are octal.
In C, scanf("%i", &n) handles 0, 0x, and decimal prefixes automatically.
learningObjectives: Understand octal, decimal, and hexadecimal number bases.
